records.source: pause 500/stopAnimation Sebastian/speak Sebastian "Decorations?... Oh, yeah... thanks. I've been sticking posters on the wall for years, I guess it's kinda cluttered."/switchEvent enterRobin
records.translation: pause 500/stopAnimation Sebastian/speak Sebastian "Mga dekorasyon?... O, oo... salamat. Ilang taon na akong nagdidikit ng mga poster sa pader, kaya medyo magulo na siguro."/switchEvent enterRobin
records.englishResidueReason: Poster is the conventional Filipino term for a printed wall display.

records.source: pause 300/message "You turn and run along a dim corridor. The cold stone slopes and spirals downward for what seems like an eternity. Finally, you emerge into a new area."/pause 400/switchEvent sewer

Alam mo na, para masubukan kong ibenta sa internet ang sining ko gaya ng iminungkahi mo."/emote farmer 32/speak Leah "Mabuti talagang may kaibigang nagmamalasakit sa iyo!"/pause 1500/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end warpOut
